text:
maria: Quick heads-up — On‑Prem Ops Playbook (Private GA) is published. It includes customer readiness checklist, HSM/KMS setup, retention policy changes, and emergency rollback steps. Read: <https://internal.redwood.io/docs/onprem-playbook|onprem-playbook>. Please scan if you own any GA prep tasks.
ops-bot: Document uploaded: ON-PREM-OPS-PLAYBOOK v1.0 by maria — 1776001234
alex: Awesome — where are the rollback commands? we need something scriptable for field engs.
maria: Put a small rollback utility in the playbook. Snippet is under "operations". Quick example:
```bash
rwctl deploy --target onprem --version previous --force-validate
```
priya: Security note: new policy requires HSM-backed key for all Private GA customers. Customers have 30 days from activation to rotate to HSM or we default to account-level soft-lock (no external backups). See section 3.2.
ethan: Confirming runtime change: we added optional KMS provider hook. Example config (YAML) in playbook: 
```yaml
kms_provider: aws_hsm
endpoint: https://hsm.example.internal
cert_fingerprint: "AB:CD:...:12"
```
samir: For sales/solutions — can we get a one-page TL;DR I can hand to prospects? they want simple checklist: infra, networking, certs, backups.
maria: Yep — created a 1-pager under docs/sales-onprem-quickstart. Samir — I'll ping you the link.
claire: Legal review: data residency blurb is included but needs an explicit backup opt-in clause for EU customers. We'll add that before GA notice.
priya: Also adding: rotation schedule must be documented in customer runbook and audit logs shipped to customer's SIEM endpoint.
ethan: SLA change for Private GA: P1 response = 2 hours (initial), oncall page updated. Full runbook section lists escalation matrix.
alex: Thanks — will add a short script to health-check containerized runtime and post to tools repo.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-tests passed for onprem-playbook v1.0 — 8 checks, 0 failures.
maria: FYI — onboarding checklist items for Eng/SE: 1) verify HSM connectivity, 2) run validation script, 3) confirm retention settings, 4) sign customer runbook. I'll post the matrix.
samir: Can we get a live demo for the first 3 pilot customers? prefer Wed or Thu next week.
maria: Scheduling AM sync Wednesday 09:00 PT to walk the playbook and answer handoff questions. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:
claire: Keep legal on the invite for the EU pilot.
priya: Will follow up with a short checklist for cert rotation and audit events.
maria: thanks all — please flag blockers on the doc thread. :rocket:
